briefing.headline: AMD jumps 6.14% as core tech leads gains
briefing.summary: All major US mega-cap tech names posted modest gains, with AMD up over 6% and the broader indices SPY and QQQ modestly higher. Nvidia was the only core decliner, slipping nearly 6%. Outside the core, crypto‑linked tokens such as PARA, SLOIF and SOXL plunged sharply, while CECO and PVLA posted the largest absolute gains among the broader set.
